Name: Advanced Dialogue Display
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is an example of what can be done with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11661]Dialogue Display Framework[/url].

Clicking on the animated character sprite opens the character's profile page.

You can tweak the layout by editing the content.json file. If you edit the file while in-game, you can save it and press F5 in-game to reload the file.



[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ as well.
